the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Write E as the intersection of the quasi-compact opens V_i; by adding finite intersections the family may be taken directed (the same refinement as in the lead-in to the sections-of-intersection equation carried as context), and then f^{-1}(E) = intersection of the f^{-1}(V_i) in X. The sections of the structure sheaf over a directed intersection are the colimit of the sections over the members by the carried equation, and for each single V_i the flat base change isomorphism Gamma(f^{-1}(V_i), O) = Gamma(V_i, O) tensor_A B is Cohomology of Schemes, flat-base-change-cohomology; assembling the two gives the displayed equality.
